title: parallelWrite
body:
## parallelWrite

Write integer or float datasets from several MPI ranks at once through parallel HDF5 (the mpio driver), each rank writing its block of axis-0 rows with collective or independent I/O, then reduce the file in parallel and verify it serially.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Needs a separately built parallel h5py (HDF5_MPI=ON) and mpiexec from configuration; the serial wheel cannot do MPI-IO. Qualified on one local workstation only (Open MPI 4.1.7, 2-3 ranks, launched on localhost), not on a cluster.
- Rank r writes rows [r*n/R, (r+1)*n/R); every rank receipt, the serial readback, h5dump and a parallel reduction must agree.

Native binding: `mpiexec -n RANKS python: h5py.File(w, driver=mpio, comm=MPI.COMM_WORLD) / collective create_dataset / per-rank axis-0 partition writes (collective or independent) / MPI allreduce read`. Output kind: `["file","text"]`.

Inputs: none.
